sentences.en: I might as well starve as do such a thing.
sentences.zh: 我与其做那样的事还不如饿死。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people have starved to death in that district.
sentences.zh: 那个地区有数百人因饥饿而死亡。

sentences.en: So many people are starving to death in the country.
sentences.zh: 这个国家有那么多人因饥饿而死亡。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：star（明星）+ve→和明星的生活正相反→挨饿
